Springback Root Cause Analysis Defect Types: deformation, dimensional inaccuracy Process: sheet metal bending Root Cause: Elastic recovery of sheet metal after forming (springback) causes the bent angle to open up beyond the intended angle. Effect: Dimensional inaccuracy in bent angles, parts out of tolerance on angular dimensions and related linear dimensions. Corrective Actions: 1. Apply overbend compensation to tooling angle 2.
